global_style: Minimalist editorial presentation with Morandi tones, distinct continuous stadium borders, and geometric image masks.

identity_anchors: Continuous 1px black stadium (pill-shaped) border framing all slide content
Small outlined circle motif placed consistently in the bottom right corner
Extreme contrast between massive, tightly tracked bold headings and tiny, tracked-out uppercase meta-labels
Images constrained strictly within geometric masks (arches, circles, perfect squares)

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
